decisions.collectorChecklist: Keep all 800 numbered cards in one Base Product Set; #1-700 low series and #701-800 high series. Original high-series packs also contain low-series cards; VCS flattens availability for set completion.
decisions.rookies: True RC suffix only where the TCDB rookie index confirms it; anchors 24/55/65/567/755 independently cross-referenced with PSA and Cardboard Connection.
decisions.printingVariations: Collapse back-hologram printing variations and the #231/#309/#636 corrections to one collector-facing base card per printed number; preserve notable corrections in Variant.
decisions.physicalPack: Original foil pack had 15 regular cards plus a team logo hologram; modeled as 16 total items. A separate low/high-series pack switch and guaranteed hologram slot require application QA.
decisions.odds: Assume an equal mix of low/high-series packs for one VCS product. Nolan Ryan Heroes and Hank Aaron Heroes each normalize from 1:6 in their own series to 1:12 across a 50/50 mix. SP1/SP2 combined normalize to 1:72 overall. Silver Sluggers were 1 per 27-card jumbo; approximate normalization for 16-card VCS packs set to 1:2. Holograms were one per foil pack. Historical odds are not asserted for HH1 or autograph variants.
decisions.scarceHeaders: Nolan Ryan/Hank Aaron Heroes header cards were SP, but the VCS set-level odds cannot express their card-specific scarcity; header weighting needs QA before release.
decisions.eventExclusives: Heroes of Baseball and their autographs were available only in specially marked event packs; modeled as collectible checklists with null standard-pack odds (not fabricated as normal foil-pack hits).
decisions.excluded: 1991 Upper Deck Final Edition is a separate 100-card boxed release; other factory-only or promo materials are excluded. Magazine insert NNO is not treated as a trading card.
decisions.numberedLogos: 28 unnumbered logo cards (26 franchises plus AL and NL) receive deterministic collector IDs NNO-01..NNO-28 in alphabetical order; those IDs are VCS identifiers, not printed numbers.
decisions.safety: Generator must collect every canonical TCDB row and validate full 878-card inventory and team data before writing CSV. Network errors or mismatches stop without producing a partial CSV.

productSets.name: Base
productSets.notes: 800 printed numbers; 1–700 low, 701–800 high; one combined collector checklist.

productSets.name: Special Prints
productSets.notes: SP1 Michael Jordan (low series), SP2 Nolan Ryan / Rickey Henderson (high series), each 1:72 in its original pack channel.

productSets.name: Hank Aaron Hologram
productSets.notes: HH1 high-series insert. Published pack insertion rate not established; no invented odds.

productSets.name: Baseball Heroes - Nolan Ryan
productSets.notes: Cards 10–18 plus unnumbered SP header. Original 1:6 in low-series; normalized 1:12 across equal low/high mix.

productSets.name: Baseball Heroes - Hank Aaron
productSets.notes: Cards 19–27 plus unnumbered SP header. Original 1:6 in high-series; normalized 1:12 across equal low/high mix.

productSets.name: Silver Sluggers
productSets.notes: 18 SS-prefixed cards; originally one per 27-card jumbo; approximate normalization to 16-card VCS product.

productSets.name: Team Logo Holograms
productSets.notes: One per original foil pack, two per jumbo. 28 unnumbered subjects assigned stable VCS-only NNO-01 to NNO-28 IDs.

productSets.name: Heroes of Baseball (Event)
productSets.notes: H1–H4; specially marked Heroes event boxes, not normal retail packs; standard-pack odds absent.

productSets.name: Nolan Ryan Heroes Autograph
productSets.notes: Autographed #18, hand numbered to 2500; low series; unknown per-pack odds.

productSets.name: Hank Aaron Heroes Autograph
productSets.notes: Autographed #27, hand numbered to 2500; high series; unknown per-pack odds.

productSets.name: Heroes of Baseball Autographs (Event)
productSets.notes: H1–H3 autographed, each numbered to 3000; only in special event packs.
